# Milestone 1A - real-Obsidian Project-task verification

Status: implemented inactive rehearsal; stop for user review. This does not complete full Milestone 1 or authorize migration rehearsal, Markdown retirement or cutover.

## Delivered scope

Exactly the ten approved existing files were edited and the sixteen approved new files created. The existing Project controller accepts an optional exact-owner native dependency. The selected synthetic private Project uses actual N2 hosting, P1 coherent reads, N3-A admission, the N3-B adapter and atomic rich creation/Save. Other Project/Resource controllers retain their legacy branch. Native references use authority/owner/task/Step UUIDs; no Markdown locator is fabricated and there is no legacy mutation or History/check fallback.

The existing Add/Edit, task rows, flat Step controls, Necessity, Description, dates, completed disclosure and modal whole-tree deletion run through the genuine Obsidian APIs in a separate Electron process. Editor, live form, task-card and plugin startup sources remain unchanged. Hidden continuation and Step bodies survive compact Save. Nested data rejects intact and its controls are disabled. Recurrence members and Phase-bound editing are rejected by the unchanged reviewed form bridge; no native controls for them were added.

## Durable requests

The explicit writer session owns version-1 marker/request sidecars under its existing admitted root and WRITER.lock. A record freezes original intent, all creation IDs, compiled request/command and checksums before dispatch, with exclusive file creation, flush, readback and lease/root checks. The admission and final publication callbacks verify the exact retained request. Conflicting stable evidence produces OPERATION_CONFLICT. The operation projection is version 3 and runs in the unchanged authoritative repository queue, returning only bounded receipt references and IDs. Native receipts remain the sole outcome authority.

Missing, corrupt, conflicting or unavailable evidence blocks additional publication; there is no automatic execution after restart, guard replacement, successor/identity regeneration, pruning or clearing API. Exact replay uses the retained original application intent. Committed creation remains confirmed after later deletion, without recreating the task. Closing drains accepted retention before releasing the native lease; disposed controllers suppress late publication. Uncertain and rejected retained requests can require manual review and remain deliberately blocking.

This is a new private host-side format. Native generations, manifests, codecs, command/receipt meanings and recovery algorithms were not edited. Updated writer hosts without retention support refuse these roots before and after lease acquisition. Older binaries/standalone readers that ignore sidecars are not made compatible by this gate.

The current application suite's single failure is its immutable B1 source-byte assertion. Its sealed 524-file graph predates accepted data-store/Music/editor/live-form work and this gate's three authorized plugin edits. The graph and assertion were not edited or skipped. All current behavioral assertions passed. Its complete unchanged 15-test legacy workflow selection, including the hash assertion, passes in the exact verified historical graph materialized only in Temp. See historical-graph-differences.json; this is not represented as a wholly green current-graph runner.

Five actual children were parent-terminated: during partial request retention, after retention/before dispatch, before native CURRENT publication, after CURRENT publication/before acknowledgement, and after commitment/before caller memory publication. Exact original intents, commands, raw native files, PID/host/token, lock bytes/hash and exit evidence are retained. Each child was awaited; death and unchanged lock identity were proven before moving that exact disposable lock. Partial evidence prevents reopening; prepublication missing receipts remain uncertain/blocked; committed postpublication work reconciles and replays the original IDs once. The last boundary includes the adapter's own coherent read but precedes any caller UI/memory publication; it is not described as a crash before every internal read.

The real-host launcher uses the installed Obsidian archive and existing Electron 39.8.3 test dependency, a new Temp profile/vault/native/evidence root and a Temp working directory. A minimal fixture plugin supplies genuine Plugin/Component/Modal/ItemView APIs. No rebuilt Itacan bundle or normal Itacan onload runs. Network, external navigation and OS protocol/startup registration effects are denied in the fixture. The automated window stays hidden and exits after the workflow; this proves actual component/controller hosting, not full plugin startup or an installed interactive production session.

## UI observation

The final real-host run demonstrated creation, Description, Must, exact date-only Due value, Edit Save, independent Step completion, parent completion/reopening, disclosure, stable UUIDs after reconstruction, legacy Project/Resource coexistence and whole-tree deletion. All retained UI mutations reconciled committed. Native global History/Statistics totals were unavailable. Add/Edit/list screenshots were captured and the existing dark compact modal and flat Steps inspected.

The final automated sample opened Add in 126.7 ms and returned creation to the list in 3750.8 ms. Earlier successful creation samples were approximately 1.45 seconds; runs overlapped other verification and were not controlled performance benchmarks. No speedup, tail latency or production responsiveness claim is made.

## Preservation and staged builds

The fresh baseline recorded 1,763 files, dirty Git state, all ten exact source originals, protected hashes and installed assets before editing. All twelve installed production assets remain identical. Temp-only baseline/final builds preserve all factory IDs/counts: main 171, Atlas 24. Only the three approved plugin factories differ: task-panel-read, tasks and task-steps. Startup construction/routing remain unchanged with one Legacy Task Service construction; no native integration package enters the production startup graph. The eleven staged assets other than main.js, including Atlas, are byte-identical.

The protected comparison found .obsidian/workspace.json drift during the gate. Its observed bytes and before/after hashes were retained without restoration or actor attribution. All other baseline files outside the ten-source allowlist match; no full protected-byte identity is claimed. Plugin data, real Markdown, History/checks, Music/C1-A/B1, Oath/Inbox, installed assets and native execution/codec/domain sources remain unchanged in the captured inventory. No live native artifact was intentionally created outside disposable storage.

## Evidence and limitations

Evidence root: `C:\Users\El_Baraka 2025\AppData\Local\Temp\itacan-m1a-audit-1xs7s5qv`. Exact commands/arguments, stdout/stderr, scalar exits, assertion summaries, initial failed harness runs, source originals/change hashes, frozen execution, build/protected comparisons, crash evidence and actual-host screenshots/results are retained there. Final SHA256 inventory covers this evidence and approved outputs; no prior evidence is overwritten. No Git reset/restore or automatic lock break was used.

Initial real-host failures concerned the virtual Obsidian module loader and assertions against retained empty modal shells; the fixture now checks actual task-form closure. Initial added-test failures used a nonexistent repository getter and were corrected to the actual queryTasks method. Declaration runner invocations without an explicit TypeScript path initially failed module resolution; all seven final explicit invocations pass. These failures remain in the audit.

One automatic review rejection incorrectly interpreted reading the existing editor declaration runner as overwriting it. That command did not execute; a self-contained new integration runner was created instead. No additional source edit was made.

There is no native Home/Schedule/Roadmap/global History/Statistics/Oath/Inbox/sharing integration, real Project selection/copy, migration, Markdown retirement, C1 adoption or production activation. Real cutover remains blocked on the separately reviewed remaining milestones. Stop for user review.
